speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help us understand your new movement issues, could you describe exactly what movements you are experiencing and when they started? Also, have you recently started or changed any psychiatric medications?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience a constant feeling of inner restlessness or an inability to sit still that improves with movement? Additionally, have you noticed any involuntary muscle stiffness, tremors, or abnormal postures in your face or limbs?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing.

speaker: Doctor
text:
This presentation is classic for akathisia, a common side effect of risperidone. I will adjust your medication regimen to alleviate this distressing restlessness.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Akathisia secondary to risperidone
